learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to count the letters in our names, find the longest and shortest names, and gather fun data about our friends!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every name is made of letters! We can count them one by one. For example, the name AMIT has 4 letters. How many letters are in your name?
Some friends have big names with many letters, which makes them the longest. Some have cute small names with fewer letters, making them the shortest. Let us compare them!
We can make a list of our friends and write how many letters are in their names next to them. This helps us easily see who has the most letters and who has the least!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Family Name Train
fun_activity.instructions: Write your family members' names on pieces of paper. Count the letters in each name and arrange them from shortest to longest to make a fun train!

quick_recap: ⭐ We can carefully count the letters in any name!
⭐ We can compare names to find out which is the longest and which is the shortest.
⭐ Putting names in a table makes it super easy to read our fun data!
